keyPoints: Prithvi ab tak ka ekmatra gyaat grah hai jahan jeevan hai — karodon grahon me yehi ek jeevit duniya hai, isiliye ye anokhi hai.
Jeevan ke liye teen cheezen zaroori hain — paani, saans lene yogya hawa aur sahi taap; in teenon ka mel sirf prithvi par milta hai.
Prithvi ke chaar mandal hain — sthalmandal (dharti), jalmandal (paani), vayumandal (hawa) aur jaivmandal (jeev) — aur ye chaaron ek-dusre se jude hain.
Vayumandal ki ozone parat suraj ki hanikarak parabaingani kiranon se hamari raksha karti hai; isme chhed hona khatre ki ghanti hai.
Manav gatividhiyon — jivashm indhan jalane, ped katne — se jalvayu badal rahi hai; ped lagana, paani bachana aur urja ki bachat iska samadhan hai.
Prithvi hamara sajha ghar hai; iski dekhbhal karna sirf sarkar ka nahi, har peedhi ke har vyakti ka kartavya hai.
Aam galti: prithvi ke sansadhan aseemit samajhna; saaf hawa aur meetha paani bhi seemit hain, inhe bachana hoga warna aane wali peedhi ko takleef hogi.

title: Hamara Ghar: Prithvi
